title: Organic Networks
description: "Organic Networks" examines the profound symbiotic relationships between natural ecosystems and modern digital civilization. Drawing inspiration from fungal mycelium, biological neural networks, and ecological cycles, the featured artworks integrate bio-art, generative models, and sculpture to mirror complex web-like structures. By blurring the line between the synthetic and the natural, the exhibition prompts viewers to reconsider how living systems collaborate, evolve, and coexist in the contemporary era.
